newsitem.title: GERMANY: German car registrations in May fall 13.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: German car registrations in May fall 13.6 percent.

text.p: New car registrations in Germany tumbled in May from the same month in 1996, the Federal Motor Office said on Thursday.
The report said passenger vehicle registrations fell 13.6 percent to 292,600 units in May from 338,790 units in May 1996 and was also down 16.6 percent from April.
In the first 10 months of 1997, the office said new vehicle registrations were down 5.1 percent at 1.512 million units.
